name: JACKAL + THOTH
author: Khephri Labs / Anubis Quantum Cipher
description: Theme-native evidence surface for JACKAL, built on Omarchy's own panel kit: a bar pill with a live call count, a keyboard-driven dropdown (activity, latest answer, recent feed, actions) and a full-screen mission-control cockpit with ledger, live graph deck, probes, verification front door, evidence register and the sealed THOTH identity. Every colour comes from the operator's theme; assurance vocabulary is rendered without promotion.

barWidget.description: JACKAL + THOTH: session function as a glyph, calls in the last hour beside it, and a dropdown with live activity, the latest answer, the recent feed and one-key actions. Click for the dropdown, middle-click for the cockpit, right-click to probe.
